street_name: Access Road From Southbury Road To 188-204 Southbury Road
description: Hybrid planning application (part detailed/part outline) for the demolition of all existing buildings and structures, site preparation works and the phased comprehensive redevelopment of part of Southbury Leisure Park comprising:Detailed Planning Application for the demolition of all buildings/structures and the removal of all existing car parking spaces across the entire application site, the re-provision of car parking spaces (for third party use), and the phased construction of two development plots delivering residential (Class C3) and flexible commercial / community uses (Classes E, F.1, and/or F.2), alongside all associated parking, plant, infrastructure, access, and hard and soft landscaping (which will deliver public realm, a new linear park, circulation routes, amenity areas, ecological enhancements and play space).Outline Planning Application (with some matters reserved- appearance, landscaping, layout, scale)for the phased construction of two development plots delivering residential (Class C3) and flexible commercial / community uses (Classes E, F.1, and/or F.2), alongside all associated parking, plant, infrastructure, access, and hard and soft landscaping (which will deliver public realm, circulation routes, amenity areas, ecological enhancements and play space). (An Environmental Statement, including a non-technical summary, also accompanies the planning application in accordance with the Town and Country Planning (Environmental Impact Assessment) Regulations 2017 (as amended)).
